# Getting help

ThoughtKnot is made by one person in their spare time. Here is where to go.

- **A question, or an idea:** ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/rogerbucks/thoughtknot/discussions).
- **Something is broken:** say what you did and what happened in [Discussions](https://github.com/rogerbucks/thoughtknot/discussions) under Q&A. The maintainer turns it into an issue.
- **How to use it:** read the [guide](https://github.com/rogerbucks/thoughtknot/wiki).
- **What comes next:** see the [roadmap](https://github.com/rogerbucks/thoughtknot/wiki/Roadmap).
- **A security problem:** do not post it in public. Follow the [security policy](https://github.com/rogerbucks/thoughtknot/security/policy).

Answers come when the maintainer has time. There is no paid support.
